title: Criteria for Similarity of Triangles — Triangles
hook: Let's explore Criteria for Similarity of Triangles from the chapter on Triangles. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Criteria for Similarity of Triangles AAA (AA), SSS, and SAS similarity criteria. If two triangles are similar, their corresponding sides are proportional and corresponding angles are equal. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 AA criterion: two pairs of equal angles ⇒ triangles are similar
💡 SSS criterion: all three pairs of sides in proportion ⇒ similar
💡 SAS criterion: one pair of equal angles between proportional sides ⇒ similar
💡 If △ABC ~ △DEF, then AB/DE = BC/EF = CA/FD and ∠A=∠D, ∠B=∠E, ∠C=∠F
